title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Mubadala DC Open?
background: The Mubadala DC Open is a professional tennis tournament in Washington, D.C. Its women's singles competition is part of the WTA Tour.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official WTA results for the 2026 Mubadala DC Open.
